messages:
Mia (SEO): Quick thread to lock the final SEO checklist for the launch posts + webinar landing. Need: slug canonicalization, keyword targets, anchor hygiene, redirect map, UTM taxonomy, and a tiny schema microcheck. Keep it lightweight.
Priya: For slugs let's standardize to kebab-case, drop dates, and prefer short semantically-rich roots (e.g., /benchmark-latency). We'll record legacy slug mappings.
Nora - Content: I'll export keyword targets per piece (primary + 2 semis) and suggested H2s. Also will annotate recommended anchor text for internal links to the webinar landing and benchmark post.
Jon (Growth): UTM taxonomy proposal: utm_source=redwood, utm_medium=content, utm_campaign={launch|webinar|benchmark}_v1. Also include page_ref hidden field on forms for lead attribution.
Kevin (Dev): I'll add a lightweight middleware to set Link: rel=canonical to canonical slug, strip ad params (fbclid,gclid,_gl) and enforce 301s for legacy slugs based on a single /seo/redirects.yaml in marketing repo. Where do you want that YAML?
Mia (SEO): Put it under marketing/seo/redirects.yaml. Keep rules explicit (no magic regex unless necessary). Also add an "anchor_hygiene" note: avoid generic CTAs, use descriptive anchors and limit same-anchor repetition on a page.
Nora - Content: On the landing I'll add FAQ schema (2 Qs min), Event/Webinar schema snippet and Article schema for benchmark. Will drop snippets in #marketing-drafts.
crawler-bot: Note: schedule a shallow crawl after redirects land. Last run 2024-05-10, 221 warnings.
Priya: I'll publish the keyword list and anchor map by EOD. Can someone own the redirects PR?
Kevin (Dev): I will. ETA PR Mon morning with middleware and a smoke test verifying canonical header and a sample legacy -> canonical 301.
Mia (SEO): Great. Target: everything live 48 hours before GA. I'll add a one-paragraph QA microcheck to the launch playbook (slug canonical, UTMs, redirects, anchor map, schema present). Ping if anything blocks.
